verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of all 112 non-MLP tensors across the three checkpoints before merging, computes each task vector against the unmodified `base` dict (the merged results go into a separate `out` copy, so no aliasing hazard), applies λ=0.4 to both vectors in float32, carries every other tensor over from the base unchanged, asserts merged == 48 and len(out) == 160, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The regex matches exactly the 48 named MLP tensors and nothing else.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
